_comment: Canonical structure descriptor template (structure/<id>.json). The engine treats the functional section as fully opaque — only brique.kind is read for catalog stamping.

brique._comment: Required. The only field the engine reads from this section.
brique._kind_note: Required. Always 'structure'. The engine stamps this automatically when absent, but it must be explicitly set.
brique._revision_note: Managed by the engine. Set to 1 on creation. The engine increments this value (as a Unix nanosecond timestamp) on every structure.patch commit. Do not set or modify manually.

objective._comment: Optional. Projected by the reflexive meaning layer.
objective.name: <structure_id>
objective._name_note: Conventionally matches the structure filename without .json.
objective.description: One sentence describing what this structure organizes.

functional._comment: Fully opaque to the engine. Use this section to describe the structure's content in any shape that fits your use case. Common pattern: an 'items' array of typed references.

items._comment: A matter reference. Preferred form for cross-context matter bindings.
items._kind_note: Informational convention. Not enforced by the engine.
items._context_note: Absolute context path that owns the referenced matter.

_subjective_note: Optional. Free-form space for subjective categorization. Add any key-value pairs meaningful to you or your team — tags, priority, notes, author opinions. The engine ignores this section entirely.
